title: Common Rail Pressure High Error 1
detail_of_failure: High pressure error (level 1) occurs in common rail circuit.
machine_effect: • The engine sound becomes larger when it is not loaded or lightly loaded. • Engine output is reduced.
related_information: • Common rail pressure can be checked with monitoring function (Code: 36400). • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Check if other failure codes are shown at the same time. If other codes are shown, do the troubleshooting for them.

The connection of the ground terminal can be defective. Check the terminals that follow. • Ground terminal of machine ((-) terminal of battery) • Engine ground terminal • Engine controller ground terminal • Starting motor ground terminal

steps.cause: Defective common rail pressure sensor system
steps.procedure: Do the troubleshooting for failure codes [CA451] and [CA452].

default_conclusion: Defective common rail pressure sensor system
